role: Declares the StrapRecordingCoordinator value type (holds only a strong PolarManager reference) on which every on-strap recording operation (start/status/storage in PolarManager+Recording.swift, transfer in StrapRecordingCoordinator+Transfer.swift, Verity Sense in PolarManager+VeritySense.swift) is written as extensions.
types: StrapRecordingCoordinator: struct (@MainActor) — stateless facade over PolarManager for strap-memory recordings; built on demand by PolarManager
toplevel: Only the struct declaration with `let manager: PolarManager` (StrapRecordingCoordinator.swift:30-32); conditional `import PolarBleSdk` under #if canImport. The doc comment names the sibling files `+Recording`, `StrapRecordingCoordinator+Transfer` and `+VeritySense`; the first and last actually live in PolarManager+Recording.swift and PolarManager+VeritySense.swift.
